method: Direct decoded native-repeat, color, alpha and hash comparisons, separate from the checker verdict; structural checks do not independently prove artistic quality.
preparation: The built-in image editor removed the illustrative magnified window and connectors. A new aspect-preserving 2048x1024 canvas was prepared by nearest-neighbor scaling; Pixelwright then projected 4px cells using the established 32-color header palette. The latest generative edit source was preserved unchanged.

observations: The magnified diagram, cyan connectors, checkmark and shield selection marker have been removed.
PIXELWRIGHT and CREATE. GRID. VERIFY. remain readable.
Knight, mace, shield, potion and inventory icon are fully framed; courtyard masonry fills the removed panel area.
The established 32-color palette and 4px grid are retained.
